premise: Fox and Deer think Woodpecker is knocking at the big tree's front door — tap tap, who's there? — until Fox listens with him and hears bugs under the bark: breakfast!
inspiration: The folk knock-knock "who's there?" game, answered truly: the tree's door opens on breakfast.
lesson: Listening closely shows you what's really going on.
learning: Woodpeckers tap on bark and listen for bugs hiding underneath.

en-US.title: Woodpecker Listens for Breakfast
en-US.text: {sfx:taps} Tap-tap-tap! Someone was knocking on the big tree. {fox:enter} Fox came trotting up, and {deer:enter} Deer came too. {fox:face surprised} {fox:wobble} [curious] Who's there? called Fox. There, on the bark, was {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Woodpecker. {deer:face happy} [giggles] Are you knocking on the tree's front door? asked Deer. {woodpecker:face happy} {woodpecker:pulse} Sort of, said Woodpecker. {woodpecker:live hold} Tap-tap-tap… and he listened, very still. {fox:go to woodpecker} Fox tiptoed closer, as quiet as he could. {fox:live hold} He pricked up his ears too. [whispers] What are we listening for? Deer didn't know, so he {deer:live} nibbled the grass. Then Fox heard it. {sfx:scritch} Scritch… scratch… munch. Tiny bugs, under the bark! {fox:live resume} Fox opened his eyes and grinned. {woodpecker:live resume} Tap! chirped Woodpecker. Breakfast! {deer:hop} Knock, knock! said Deer. {fox:face happy} Who's there? said Fox. {all:face happy} {all:wobble} [laughs] BREAKFAST! said everyone.

es-ES.title: Carpintero escucha su desayuno
es-ES.text: {sfx:taps} ¡Toc-toc-toc! Alguien llamaba al árbol grande. {fox:enter} Zorro llegó trotando, y {deer:enter} Ciervo también. {fox:face surprised} {fox:wobble} [curious] ¿Quién es? preguntó Zorro. Allí, en la corteza, estaba {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Pájaro carpintero. {deer:face happy} [giggles] ¿Estás llamando a la puerta del árbol? preguntó Ciervo. {woodpecker:face happy} {woodpecker:pulse} Más o menos, dijo Carpintero. {woodpecker:live hold} Toc-toc-toc… y se quedó escuchando, muy quieto. {fox:go to woodpecker} Zorro se acercó de puntillas, sin hacer ruido. {fox:live hold} Levantó las orejas él también. [whispers] ¿Qué estamos escuchando? Ciervo no lo sabía, así que {deer:live} mordisqueó la hierba. Entonces Zorro lo oyó. {sfx:scritch} Ris… ras… ñam. ¡Bichitos, debajo de la corteza! {fox:live resume} Zorro abrió los ojos y sonrió. {woodpecker:live resume} ¡Toc! pió Carpintero. ¡El desayuno! {deer:hop} ¡Toc, toc! dijo Ciervo. {fox:face happy} ¿Quién es? dijo Zorro. {all:face happy} {all:wobble} [laughs] ¡El DESAYUNO! dijeron todos.
